title: Woman Punches Cop Who Tried To Save Her Life
description:
On July 29th, 2022, officers observed a female walking in the middle of the road. She was exhibiting signs of intoxication and when questioned she expressed suicidal intentions and a desire to die. The officers were worried for the female’s well being and invoked the baker act which provides emergency mental health services and temporary detention for people with mental illness. The Baker Act is similar to an emergency department for people experiencing a medical emergency. The female’s demeanor quickly turned racist and uncooperative before she attempted to swing at one of the officers. The female was charged with battery on a law enforcement officer.
